notice.title: Before you start
notice.p1: It uses curated, predefined teaching scenarios and fictional demo products. It does not diagnose or prescribe, and it is not a substitute for professional advice.
notice.l1: Product names, brands and manufacturers are fictional.
notice.l2: Medicine classification (OTC / pharmacist-only / prescription) differs between countries and is simplified here.
notice.l3: In real life, always follow your local regulations and a qualified pharmacist or doctor.
notice.p2: In the game, safety always matters more than sales.
about.name: RxShift Pharmacy Training Simulator
about.p1: A 3D training game: talk to customers, ask the right questions, choose safe medicines, refer when needed, and pass the inspection.
about.content: Content: 56 curated customer scenarios, {n} fictional catalog items built on real active ingredients, and {q} inspection questions across 10 modules.
about.safety: Safety: educational content is predefined and reviewed — no generative AI prescribes. Information is simplified and may not reflect your local regulations or the latest guidance.
about.touch: Touch: left joystick to move (push fully or tap RUN to sprint), swipe the screen to look, pinch to zoom, tap people/shelves/POS to walk there and interact, tap the floor to walk.
about.keys: Keyboard: WASD/arrows move · Shift run · E or Space interact · Z/C rotate camera · −/= zoom · V view · R recenter.
ctl.title: How to play
ctl.moveT: Drag the stick in the bottom-left corner. Push it all the way, or tap RUN, to run.
ctl.lookT: Swipe anywhere outside the buttons to turn the camera. Pinch with two fingers to zoom.
ctl.camT: Hold the arrows to rotate, use the magnifiers to zoom, the target to recenter behind you, and the eye for first-person view.
ctl.actT: When you are near something useful (customer, shelf, POS, fridge), the big round button shows what it will do. Tap it.
ctl.tapT: Tap a customer, shelf, POS, fridge or the floor — your pharmacist walks there and interacts automatically.
ctl.pickT: Open a shelf or the cabinet, read the medicine information, then tap ADD TO CUSTOMER or drag the product icon into the dispensing tray.
ctl.guideT: Not sure what to do? Tap the Guide button or the objective at the top. The mentor tells you where to go, what to ask and which medicine to pick.
ctl.keysT: WASD/arrows move · Shift run · E/Space interact · Z/C rotate · −/= zoom · V view · R recenter.
